QUOTE: "The combination rule is `resolved = (tier1 or tier2 or tier5) union tier3 union tier4`. In the index's words: "you can correct our guesses; you cannot un-discover a fact." ... "Facts and ecosystem entries always accumulate. Tiers 3 and 4 survive every stated tier."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that stated tiers replace one another (tier 1 and tier 2 each replace the layer beneath) while discovered tiers 3 and 4 accumulate and survive every stated tier.
